verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions workflows are defined and run inside the repository. That places automations under the product's own versioning, and the pull request workflow lets you review changes before merging. Copilot cloud agent work also happens on a branch with a reviewable diff. However, no evidence describes rolling back an automation, and no source explicitly says workflow definitions are versioned like code. Missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of automations, explicit docs on versioning workflow definitions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository with GitHub Actions.
